title: Every Last Joule — per-region snapshot
description: Schema for data/snapshots/last-good/<regionId>.json. One snapshot per region per build. Single-region loaders emit the object below; multi-region loaders (aemo, brazil-ne, entsoe, ercot, ercot-native, norway) emit a Record<regionId, this>. The runtime source of truth is the RegionData interface in src/lib/types.ts. See dataset/SCHEMA.md for the human-readable description.

profile.description: 30-day trailing average curtailment in GW, one value per UTC hour (index 0 = 00:00–01:00 UTC).

latestProfile.description: Single-day latest snapshot in GW per UTC hour. Null when the loader cannot pin a single most-recent UTC day (e.g. when the upstream feed is built from a multi-day rolling window without a daily anchor). Loaders that publish a same-day raw curve emit a 24-element array; loaders that don't emit null.

lastUpdated.description: Calibration-anchor date: YYYY, YYYY-Q#, or ISO-8601.

lastSuccessAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this snapshot was last successfully refreshed. Cache fallbacks use this to distinguish recent cached data from degraded stale data.

sourceNote.description: Optional human-readable provenance string surfaced in the dashboard tooltip and paper Usage Notes. Absent on legacy snapshots that pre-date the provenance-string convention.

sourceStatus.description: Per-fetch freshness. Whether the last fetch was fresh (live), a recent withFallback snapshot (cached), or a stale withFallback snapshot beyond the configured staleness threshold (degraded). Distinct from sourceProvenance, which records what kind of upstream link the region has.

sourceProvenance.description: Required per-region declaration of the upstream link kind, orthogonal to confidenceTier. verified = snapshot value comes from a verified upstream feed or anchor. official-lead = authoritative source exists and loader is wired/scaffolded but the live path is not producing usable data (geoblocked, auth-gated, parser pending). modelled-fallback = no verified upstream link; snapshot is typical-shape scaled to an anchor or otherwise estimated. The 'exclude' status never appears in snapshots; excluded regions are not emitted. See docs/methodology/tier-classification-guide.md#source-provenance-orthogonal-to-tier.

fuelShare.description: Optional fuel-type split of the curtailed energy, fractions 0–1. Loaders that pull technology-separated feeds (e.g. ONS Brazil) populate this; loaders that don't omit the field. The runtime keys in src/lib/types.ts are {solar, wind, hydro}; the historical snapshot corpus also contains {geothermal} from earlier loader generations. Keys outside this enum should be treated as data-quality issues.

uncertaintyLowGW.description: Lower bound of the per-tier envelope on peakGW (max(0, peakGW − δ)). Half-width δ is per-tier: 2σ from the 5-year backfill where available, else ±15% (T1) / ±20% (T2) / ±40% (T3). Derived deterministically by src/lib/uncertainty.ts::deriveTier; see docs/methodology/uncertainty.md for the methodology.

uncertaintyHighGW.description: Upper bound of the per-tier envelope on peakGW (peakGW + δ). Same per-tier δ as uncertaintyLowGW.

observedStdGW.description: Empirical standard deviation of historical annual peakGW, used for T1 2σ uncertainty bounds when available.

confidenceTier.description: Deterministic source-quality classification. Per B4 Option B (locked 2026-04-25, see docs/proposals/b4-option-b-decision.md), T1 is subdivided into T1a (own-jurisdiction calibration rate; ±15%), T1b (domestic-stat-agency rate or modelled-share split; empirical ±50%), and T1c (neighbour-extrapolated rate; empirical ±35.5%). T2 = static anchored to a published annual (Ember, IRENA, TSO annual; ±20%). T3 = static annual + typical-shape profile (solar/wind/hydro-seasonal/mixed/overnight; ±40%). T4 is reserved in the enum for symmetry but is never emitted — structural-gap regions do not appear in the dataset at all. The pre-2026-04-25 single label "T1-live-TSO" is retained for backward compatibility on legacy snapshots; new emissions use T1a/T1b/T1c. Derived deterministically by src/lib/uncertainty.ts::deriveTier; see docs/methodology/uncertainty.md.
